batch103
Snapshot: Candidate 95b1839836a0264d670a53610c97903d2c4e2de4; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU base 3b5c1f7618419ab0ae95b1c0be8e02d942c6e371. Opening and closing gates passed; 4 strokes raw-identical.
Scope: Every requested window returned completely (exit 0): current Russian guidance and all 3 rubrics; 4 complete EN/RU kanji lessons; all 13 EN/RU context pairs; all 3 EN-only comparisons; 14 KANJIDIC2 records, radical evidence/header, 65 JMdict entries, 4 KanjiPedia entries; all 358 typed pool rows; proposals, adjudications, clarifications, overlaps and 5 navigation diffs. No unread windows.
C1 CLEAN: Readings, counts, radical numbers, JLPT community labels, examples and bounded meaning/mnemonic claims in the four lessons align with reviewed frozen source and official evidence. No confirmed Japanese-fact defect.
C2 NEEDS FIX: All five diffs are navigation-only and link the existing target; four lesson adjudications and four bounded dictionary clarifications are supported. N010 is unsafe as a negative (finding below). Actual rendered quiz option/fallback behavior was not directly observed.
C3 CLEAN: Russian is comprehensible and generally natural; wrappers preserve readability. No confirmed correctable defect.
N001宅→守 S-intro: Home vs guard/obey; no direct overlap in reviewed meanings; bounded negative acceptable.
N002宅→字 S-intro: Residence vs written character/letter; no meaning overlap.
N003宅→安 S-intro: Residence vs cheap/peaceful/safe; home-safety context is association, not equivalent meaning.
N004守→宅 S-intro: Protect/obey vs home; 留守 house-sitting is a whole-word sense, not a meaning of 守 alone.
N005守→字 S-intro: Protect/obey vs written character; no overlap.
N006守→安 S-intro: Protect/obey vs cheap/peaceful; safety is a related domain, not the same gloss or sense.
N007完→元 S-intro: Complete/perfect vs origin/former; shape link is not semantic equivalence.
N008完→院 S-intro: Complete vs institution/temple/school; no overlap.
N009完→安 S-intro: Complete/perfect vs cheap/peaceful; no overlap.
N010実→完 REJECT: Unsafe negative; 実 also has a fullness/content sense, overlapping 完 «полный».
N011実→春 S-intro: Reality/fruit vs spring/prime of life; no shared answer sense found.
N012実→失 S-intro: Reality/fruit/good result vs loss/error; contrast, not overlap.
L001宅 SUPPORTED-bounded: Home/housing senses, 6 strokes, key/readings and nonhistorical mnemonic supported.
L002守 SUPPORTED-bounded: Protect/obey, readings, transitivity and 留守 whole-word caveat supported.
L003完 SUPPORTED-bounded: Completion/perfection contrast, readings and non-etymological mnemonic supported.
L004実 SUPPORTED-bounded: Reality/fruit/result senses and mnemonic disclaimer supported; fullness sense additionally matters to N010.
A001宅 SUPPORTED-bounded: Clarifications match reviewed dictionary senses; no frequency claim.
A002守 SUPPORTED-bounded: Clarifications match reviewed senses and scope.
A003完 SUPPORTED-bounded: Clarifications match reviewed senses and scope.
A004実 SUPPORTED-bounded: Clarifications match reviewed senses and scope.
NAV01 words/お宅.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps existing 宅, correct target.
NAV02 words/実に.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps existing 実, correct target.
NAV03 words/実際.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps existing 実, correct target; CRLF preserved.
NAV04 words/現実.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps existing 実, correct target; CRLF preserved.
NAV05 words/留守.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps existing 守, correct target.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001 LIMIT/no new guard (宅–家/住 domain overlap; not direct edge); O002 LIMIT/no new guard (守–助 protection/help; not direct edge); O003 LIMIT/no new guard (完–終 completion overlap; not direct edge); O004 LIMIT/no new guard (実–真/本 truth/reality overlap; not direct edge). Existing 院/完 unlinked mention and 留守 wording remain outside the changed scope.
Findings: C2—kanji/実.md front matter `distractors` (実→完; see also `Чтения`, み/みの.る): the distractor title 完 «завершённый; полный» can fit 実's official みちる/content-full sense, so a learner may be marked wrong for a defensible answer. Replace 完 with a nonoverlapping distractor; keep the shape comparison in prose. Evidence: KANJIDIC2 record includes みち.る; KanjiPedia 実 entry (https://www.kanjipedia.jp/kanji/0002945100) lists みちる/内容がそなわる; pool row 実 title and 完 title. Confidence: high.
Optional: In kanji/守.md «Русский перевод зависит от того, что именно 守る» is understandable but slightly awkward; the following examples already clarify it, so polish is not required.
Limits: No web_fetch used. No tests/builds/validators run as instructed. Judged typed quiz titles, listed senses and direct directions; did not exercise rendered quiz or fallback selection. Scope is limited to assigned windows; no native-speaker or learning-outcome claim.
